name: Second Spirit Totem
body:
You can bond with two spirit totems.

Prerequisite: Spirit totem class feature, 7th level.

Benefit: Select a second spirit totem.

Whenever you gain a totem bonus feat or totemic aspect in your class progression, you can choose options from either of your spirit totems.

Normal: You only gain one spirit totem.
